title: Who needs more time: model-relative impact numbers from the recorded 2025 planner cache
statement: Every number describes what the WildfireGuardian Route-Check API concluded for recorded fire-scenario members of the March 2025 Uiseong-Andong and Yeongdeok fires (planner cache, computed on the evaluated macOS host). None is an evacuation outcome.

generator.independent_check: research/solve2027-impact/verify.py (path B: research/solve2027-impact/wfg_impact/path_b.py, pandas + networkx, recomputes every key from route_checks)

definitions_common.population: checked OSM origins (villages/hamlets + care facilities with an accepted road entry node within 2 km; research-mission origins and the 3 not-checkable villages excluded)
definitions_common.cell_verdict: the cell verdict at a departure offset follows the planner (planner/src/domain/plan.ts combineVerdicts, lines 106-111): checked_route if ANY of the origin's candidate destinations has a checked route, model_no_route only if EVERY attempted destination is model_no_route, otherwise unresolved; re-checks replace the attempt they re-ran (planner/src/api/cache.ts lines 120-145)
definitions_common.leave_by_deadline: leave-by deadline (출발 마감) = the latest departure offset whose cell is checked_route (plan.ts latestSafeDeparture, lines 155-161); offsets are 0, 600, ..., 3000 s after the recorded input time; unresolved cells never count

caveats: Fire scenarios: each recorded input time has 4 scenario members drawn independently per 375 m cell from the c651 forecast ("fire scenarios from the forecast"); they are not fire-spread simulations of the actual fire.

Horizon: 1 hour after each recorded input time. Departures were checked every 10 minutes (0-50 min); times between checked departures are not checked, and a leave-by deadline of +50 min means the window may extend later.

Roads: provisional historical OpenStreetMap snapshot (2025-03-21) at an assumed 40 km/h (rounded up to 1 s ticks), no congestion, missing one-way tags assumed two-way, no field validation of passability.

Destinations: for each place the 3 nearest (straight line) OpenStreetMap destinations with distinct road entry nodes; those used are OSM schools, community halls and one OSM-mapped shelter (keys destinations_used.*) - not official evacuation shelters. Travel between a mapped point and its road entry node is not modelled. Places come from a 2026-10-17 OSM extract (current data) while the road graph is the pre-fire snapshot.

Host: the cache was computed by the Route-Check API on the evaluated macOS arm64 host (purpose "booth") with the fixed 30 s request budget; timed-out checks that were re-checked are shown as their re-check, as in the planner.

Model-relative: checked_route = a route that passed the checks within the model and its inputs; model_no_route is not proof that escape is impossible; unresolved = cannot judge, never safe. None of these numbers are evacuation outcomes, observed travel times or casualties avoided.
